weaponMasteryModifiers.status: User-confirmed +1 applies only to the actual Tech Weapon granted by Technician.
weaponMasteryModifiers.targetSelector: Exact weapon instance created by this Technician tech-weapon child invocation/grant, never definition-wide or all-owned.
weaponMasteryModifiers.timing: Register the original authorized source modifier once when earned. Resolve raw mastery/Resilient at the ordinary scheduled stage; calculate this bonus only in final bonus phase from the retained immutable base, never at the earlier draw.
weaponMasteryModifiers.formula: effectiveWeaponRankIndex = immutableRolledWeaponRankIndex + sum(distinct active modifiers matching this weaponInstanceId)
weaponMasteryModifiers.lateActivation: Register new source as pending. Before final phase do not project; within final phase refresh from the same retained immutable base plus current distinct sources, preserving God instance overrides. No mastery redraw or compounded bonus.
weaponMasteryModifiers.enchantment: At final bonus phase, effective Weapon Mastery after this scoped bonus qualifies at Master=5 or above only with active enchantable weapon/unused compatible slot. Deduplicate slot activation; existing acquisition lock still applies.
weaponMasteryModifiers.cap: Configured ordered Weapon Mastery scale; +1 means one rank step, not a stat point or automatic fixed Master. Rank scale remains pending.

stageBonusTickets.emptyOutcomePolicy: Normal Power pool, including None when allowed; extra spin is guaranteed, not a guaranteed power. Existing God 80/20 normal-pool rule also applies when its guard matches.

stageBonusTickets.idempotence: Register one ticket per actual Fantasy/MC source. Consume atomically with its actual bonus result. A late ticket runs the required subflow then restores saved caller.

flowContract.npc: Every Genre NPC retains Genre+Role only. No Cheat, Fantasy ticket, Romance ending/count, Sci-fi role, tech/mecha, Action Strength or Sport Speed event.
flowContract.mcDispatch: One profile keyed by this source component’s committed Genre and MC Role; no second Genre spin and no cross-component borrowed role/genre.
flowContract.returnPolicy: Nested origin/host/Hybrid calls finish this source Anime event then restore exact saved continuation. Main Archetype begins only after the outer race event tree completes.
flowContract.raceHistory: Anime consumes canonical anime-lineage once. Genre, role, title references, powers and vehicles create no extra family selection, no new no-repeat key and no automatic Hybrid/Skeleton/Heavenly/Demon events.
flowContract.profileAuthority: These profiles/wheels are canonical; race design imports are references, never second registrations or duplicate invocations.
flowContract.idempotence: Stable component/parent/step/ordinal invocation IDs; restore committed result and finish unfinished children on replay. One grant/ticket/modifier/stat effect per stable source key.

numericEffects.timing: Register once at the committed MC Role result and project after its base stat. Late sources recompute final from immutable base plus distinct ledger entries.

masteryContract.weapon: Full owned inventory after main acquisition/details and queued bonuses; every GF and Tech instance receives ordinary per-instance Weapon Mastery once. Technician modifier targets only its actual Tech child grant.
masteryContract.power: All Cheat and Fantasy-acquired powers retain the one shared character Power Mastery contract. No acquisition count multiplies mastery draws, no new power Enchant.
masteryContract.none: Main None adds nothing and erases no early weapon or power.
